Title:
Infrastructure and Microsoft Services Security Specialist

Company:
Royal Processor Tiam | Royal Pardaz Tiam

Job category:
IT / DevOps / Server

Location:
Tehran

Employment type:
Full time

Minimum experience:
three to six years

Salary:
Agreement

Required skill tags:
- Network configuration
- PowerShell
- network infrastructure

Gender:
It doesn't matter

Military service:
Permanent exemption

Education:
Bachelor's degree

Date posted:
2026-07-26

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
At Royal Process Team, as guardians of cyberspace and architects of information security, we have a mission that goes beyond the usual boundaries of digital security. To achieve this goal, we are looking for a cybersecurity infrastructure and Microsoft services expert to assess the security posture of servers and Microsoft services and to develop and provide security requirements, Best Practices, and hardening solutions. Key Responsibilities: Investigating vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses and providing corrective suggestions; Specialized review and response to security requests and tickets; Reviewing security settings, access controls, and Group Policies; Preparing checklists, technical documentation, and security reports; Automating assessment and audit processes with PowerShell. Specialized Competencies: Mastery of Windows Server hardening and services such as Active Directory, ADFS, ADCS, Exchange, and SCCM; Mastery of Active Directory security concepts, special permissions, Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, and Group Policy; Familiarity with Microsoft Security Baseline, CIS Benchmark, and other Hardening standards; Ability to analyze vulnerabilities, configuration weaknesses, and provide practical solutions; Mastery of PowerShell for information gathering, auditing, and security reporting; Familiarity with security logs, SIEM, and EDR for evidence analysis; Skill in troubleshooting Windows, Active Directory, and Microsoft services; Ability to prepare documentation and communicate security requirements to technical teams.

Company description:
At "Royal-Pardaz Tiam," we are eager to shape a digital and secure future by providing innovative services and solutions in the field of cybersecurity. Today, on the eighteenth anniversary of the company's establishment, we are recognized as a leading provider in cybersecurity services and are trusted by key players in the Information and Communications Technology (ICT) industry. We owe this trust to our collaboration with young, talented Iranian specialists. It is our pride if you also join the members of our skilled and specialized teams and use your valuable experiences to protect your country's cybersecurity.
